sources.title: Do We Really Use Only 10 Percent of Our Brain? - Britannica
sources.excerpt: how did we come to believe that 90 percent of our brain is useless?

reasoning: Decades of rigorous neuroscience research have thoroughly debunked the assertion that humans only use 10% of their brains. Modern neuroimaging technologies, such as fMRI and PET scans, demonstrate that almost all areas of the brain are active during routine daily tasks, and even during sleep. Furthermore, any brain regions left genuinely unused due to injury or disease rapidly degrade (atrophy) or are repurposed, confirming that there is no dormant, untapped 90% of brain tissue in healthy individuals.
